data.rationale: No data has been provided on the NG collaboration portal as of 30 Jul that is currently reviewable for virtually all of SLC equities. While the WBS is structured correctly, and appears to have a sufficient number of WP’s and PP’s based on WP titles alone, without a WBS dictionary to validate the scope of the WBS WP’s, a review cant be reasonably completed.

areas.text: The scope validation is currently the highest risk for this review. For reference WBS 1.04.02.05.02 has 3 CA’s, 9 WPs and 1 PP. This appears at first glance to be a reasonable amount of packages. However, the work described could easily be duplicated and overlap with CA 1.04.02.05.03, as both describe HW engineering, but the WBS Dictionary assigns this works to the USAF 625th STOS. No deliveries or expected workload are described.The level of detail for CA’s is also insufficient. From the above, 1.04.02.05.02 is for integrated assemblies, which is also assumed to be integrated LRUs. 1.04.02.05.03 is for Cabling. Both CAs have WP’s related to the RSD. As of 31 July, the technical scope either is inapplicable to the workload described, or is “peanut butter smeared,” in that all CA’s describe every cost account as doing all work for the entire program.
